article.summary: Progressive US Sen. Ed Markey, a champion of Medicare for All and the Green New Deal, decisively fended off a Democratic primary challenge from his right on Tuesday, defeating Rep. Seth Moulton by nearly 30 percentage points in a contest that focused heavily on the incumbent senator's age.Markey, 80, and his supporters—including prominent young Democrats such asRep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez(D-NY)—rejected the notion that "generational change" necessarily means electing the youngest candidate in the race.
